elf_window_4k.stmt_post: lemma elf_window_4k: "\<lbrakk> kernel_elf_base \<le> vref; vref < kernel_elf_base + (1 << pageBits) \<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> table_index (pt_slot_offset max_pt_level riscv_global_pt_ptr vref) = elf_index"

irq_node_in_kernel_window_init_arch_stat.stmt_pre: lemma irq_node_in_kernel_window_init_arch_state': "\<lbrakk> init_irq_node_ptr + m \<le> x; x \<le> init_irq_node_ptr + m + mask cte_level_bits; m \<le> mask (size (irq::irq)) << cte_level_bits\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> x \<in> kernel_window_2 (riscv_kernel_vspace init_arch_state)"

irq_node_pptr_base_kernel_elf_base.stmt_pre: lemma irq_node_pptr_base_kernel_elf_base: "\<lbrakk>x \<le> pptr_base + (m + (mask cte_level_bits + 0x3000)); m \<le> mask (size irq) << cte_level_bits \<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> \<not> kernel_elf_base \<le> x" for irq::irq
irq_node_pptr_base_kernel_elf_base.stmt_post: lemma irq_node_pptr_base_kernel_elf_base: fixes irq::irq assumes "x \<le> pptr_base + (m + (mask cte_level_bits + 0x3000))" assumes "m \<le> mask (size irq) << cte_level_bits" shows "\<not> kernel_elf_base \<le> x"

kernelELFPAddrBase_addrFromKPPtr.stmt_post: lemma kernelELFPAddrBase_addrFromKPPtr: "\<lbrakk> kernel_elf_base \<le> vref; vref < kernel_elf_base + (1 << pageBits) \<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> addr_from_ppn (ucast (kernelELFPAddrBase && ~~ mask toplevel_bits >> pageBits)) + (vref && mask (pt_bits_left max_pt_level)) = addrFromKPPtr vref"

kernel_elf_window_init_st.stmt_post: lemma kernel_elf_window_init_st: "kernel_elf_window init_A_st = { kernel_elf_base ..< kernel_elf_base + (1 << pageBits) }"

kernel_window_bits_table_index.stmt_post: lemma kernel_window_bits_table_index: "\<lbrakk> pptr_base \<le> vref; vref < pptr_base + (1 << kernel_window_bits) \<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> table_index (pt_slot_offset max_pt_level riscv_global_pt_ptr vref) = 0x100"

kernel_window_init_st.stmt_post: lemma kernel_window_init_st: "kernel_window init_A_st = { pptr_base ..< pptr_base + (1 << kernel_window_bits) }"

merge_kernelELFPAddrBase_masks.stmt_post: lemma merge_kernelELFPAddrBase_masks: "((kernelELFPAddrBase && ~~ mask 30) + (pptrTop + (kernelELFPAddrBase && mask 30) - kernelELFPAddrBase)) = pptrTop"

pt_walk_init_A_st.stmt_pre: lemma pt_walk_init_A_st[simp]: "pt_walk max_pt_level level riscv_global_pt_ptr vref (ptes_of init_A_st) = Some (max_pt_level, riscv_global_pt_ptr)"
